jsonLd.description:
FRESHLY PAINTED Shaughnessy house rental - $5999 for upper 2 levels or $8499 for the whole house with 7+ Bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms & 2 kitchens. Rare opportunity to rent a whole house with a separate basement suite in prestigious First Shaughnessy.  The above pricing is for leases beginning before Sept 15th.  Leases beginning after Sept 15, will be $750/month additional.

* HUGE LOT - A double wide 54 X130 lot (not like the small 25 or 30 foot lots found in most of Vancouver) -- You don't have to choose between moving to the boonies & commuting an hour + everyday just to have a decent sized lot OR living in a decent location and opening your front door into your neighbour's yard.

* HUGE DECK - & private yard with mature apple and fig trees for summer lounging & relaxing and those fun backyard BBQ's.

* ARBUTUS GEENWAY / SEAWALL ACCESS - This property fronts onto the Arbutus Greenway - the South Arm of the Vancouver Seawall - connecting False Creek to the Fraser River.

* LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION - Rare combination of a suite on a large lot that is near transit, shopping, beaches, & downtown -- In Vancouver's most prestigious and affluent neighbourhood! Situated blocks away from the soon to be completed Arbutus station of the Broadway Skytrain line.

* SUPER TRANSIT FRIENDLY CONVENIENCE - # 33 & # 16 Buses to UBC or 29th Ave station right outside the property, With bus stops right outside the property, and located at a major transit hub going North, South East or West is super easy. 4 bus stops right outside your door....Think of all the extra sleeping in time !

* GROCERY STORE AT YOUR DOOR - It's tough to find good quality healthy, tasty food - conveniently...but not here! There is a Loblaw's City Market right across the street, where you can get healthy food and groceries with no need to drive or pay crazy high delivery fees.

* THE BEST SCHOOLS - This house falls in the catchment area for the prestigious Shaughnessy Elementary school, mere doors away from York House School Early Childhood Learning Centre, as well as being very close to York House School, Vancouver College, Little Flower Academy, the best schools that Vancouver has to offer. Easy UBC access too!

* UBC / UNIVERSITY ACCESS - Super Easy access to UBC, and downtown schools and universities like SFU & BCIT.

* BIKE SHARE FRIENDLY - Don't have your own bike ? - No worries, pick up one of the MOBI Bike share bikes at the MOBI Bike share station right across the street

* SAFETY AND SECURITY -- located in Vancouver's most prestigious neighbourhood of Shaughnessy and surrounded by safe tree lined streets this property has the additional security of a LARGE fenced / hedged in yard with mature apple & fig trees

* LIFESTYLE & CONVENIENCE - blocks to trendy 4th Ave, funky Broadway with some of Vancouver's best dining and entertainment pubs, restaurants, etc & classy South Granville shopping - Walking distance to Caper's / Whole Foods / IGA, Yoga studios, Subway, dry cleaning & banks etc

RENTAL OPTIONS:
B) $5999 per month – UPPER 2 LEVELS ONLY: - Upper 2 levels, 4 - 5 bedrooms plus living room, dining room, kitchen & 2 baths.

B) $8999 per month - WHOLE HOUSE RENTAL: - Upper 2 levels as listed above, plus with a 2 bedroom separate suite that you can rent for only $2500+/month, and you get to choose who you want to live next to
